request.text: Sublet available now! Private room in a 4 bedroom house by the University of Waterloo, 700 CAD a month. I'm currently in Vancouver so I can't show it, but e-transfer the first and last month to lock it in before someone else takes it.

overall_badge.label: HIGH RISK
overall_badge.message: High risk detected. Do not send money, deposits, or sensitive personal information.

response.summary: A sublet listing for a private room near University of Waterloo requiring upfront e-transfer payment without in-person viewing.
action_checklist: Never send a deposit, holding fee, or rent by Zelle, e-transfer, wire, or gift cards.
Demand an in-person walkthrough or live interactive video call. If they refuse, walk away.
Ask for their full legal name and check the property address on municipal rental licensing records.
Reverse-image search all listing photos to see if they are copied from legitimate real estate sites.
Remember: in Ontario and many jurisdictions, damage deposits are illegal—only first/last month is permitted.

findings.title: Pay before you can verify
findings.quote: e-transfer the first and last month to lock it in before someone else takes it
findings.summary: Asking for payment before the student can verify the property or see it in person. Asking for a deposit or fee before you've seen the place, signed a lease, or started a job is how most rental and job scams take money.

evidence.detail: Official consumer-protection guidance describing this warning sign

data.explanation: Asking for a deposit or fee before you've seen the place, signed a lease, or started a job is how most rental and job scams take money.
data.why: Asking for payment before the student can verify the property or see it in person.

findings.title: Hard-to-reverse payment method
findings.quote: I'm currently in Vancouver so I can't show it, but e-transfer the first and last month to lock it in before someone else takes it.
findings.summary: Wire transfers, gift cards, crypto, e-transfers, and instant payment apps are nearly impossible to get back once sent. Consumer-protection agencies in the US and Canada list requests to pay this way as a warning sign.

evidence.detail: Official consumer-protection guidance describing this warning sign

data.explanation: Wire transfers, gift cards, crypto, e-transfers, and instant payment apps are nearly impossible to get back once sent. Consumer-protection agencies in the US and Canada list requests to pay this way as a warning sign.

findings.title: Web check: 700 CAD a month
findings.summary: A typical 1‑bedroom in Waterloo averages around $1,900/month, with a range roughly $1,400–$2,600. Paying $700/month is far below market rates.

evidence.detail: Web source cited by the search

data.question: Is 700.0 (per month) a normal rent for a 1-bedroom in Waterloo, Ontario, CA? Give the typical range.

findings.title: You can't see it in person
findings.quote: I'm currently in Vancouver so I can't show it
findings.summary: The landlord cannot show the property in person, preventing verification. Landlords who are abroad or can't show the unit are a common rental scam story.

evidence.detail: Official consumer-protection guidance describing this warning sign

data.explanation: Landlords who are abroad or can't show the unit are a common rental scam story.
data.why: The landlord cannot show the property in person, preventing verification.

findings.title: Pressure to decide fast
findings.quote: lock it in before someone else takes it
findings.summary: Creating pressure to decide and pay quickly to avoid losing the opportunity. Scammers rush you so you don't have time to check. A real offer survives a day of verification.

evidence.detail: Official consumer-protection guidance describing this warning sign
